_comment: Two classes of extra, each at one flat price. Packages include a number of picks from these lists (packages.json → tiers[].picks); anything beyond that is bought at the price below. A price is stated once per class, not repeated on every tile.

classes.name: Page add-ons
classes.blurb: One more page on the site, designed and written to match the rest of it.

items.name: Services page
items.blurb: Everything you do, what it costs and who it is for.

items.name: Menu page
items.blurb: Up to 20 items as real text, not a photographed PDF.

items.name: Photo gallery
items.blurb: Your own work, sized and compressed so it loads on mobile data.

items.name: Before / after gallery
items.blurb: Paired shots of the same job, which is what sells detailing and repair work.

items.name: Testimonials page
items.blurb: Your real reviews, pulled together in one place people can read.

items.name: About / team page
items.blurb: Who runs the business and why a stranger should trust it.

items.name: FAQ page
items.blurb: The questions you answer on the phone ten times a week.

items.name: Service area page
items.blurb: The towns and neighbourhoods you cover, written so Google can read them.

classes.name: Power features
classes.blurb: Something the site does, rather than something it shows. These are builds, not pages.

items.name: Online booking
items.blurb: Customers book a slot from the site, at nine at night, without calling you.

items.name: Quote / catering requests
items.blurb: A form that asks the questions you need answered before you can quote.

items.name: Large menu with categories
items.blurb: 20+ items, sectioned and filterable instead of one endless list.

items.name: Self-editable content
items.blurb: Change your own menu, services or gallery without calling me.

items.name: Before / after slider
items.blurb: Drag across one photo to reveal the other. It stops people scrolling.

items.name: Delivery platform links
items.blurb: DoorDash, Uber Eats and the rest, wired into the buttons people look for.

items.name: Multi-location support
items.blurb: Separate hours, addresses and maps for every place you operate.
